description: Find all matching bibliographic records using keywords or identifiers; use fetch with a returned ID for complete public metadata. All matches are returned by default; optional per_page and page request a smaller page. Use get_dataset_downloads to preserve an exact research input.

per_page.description: Omit or use all for every match. A positive integer requests an optional smaller result set.

query.description: Keywords, a title, author or DOI. This is bibliographic keyword search, not a semantic question-answering engine.

name: search
title: Search research records
